title: The Weather Today and Yesterday
text:
Today the weather is sunny. The sky is blue and there are no clouds. It is hot, so many people wear shorts and hats. We like this weather.

Yesterday it was cold and rainy. The sky was grey. I wore a warm coat and my boots. Tomorrow the weather will be windy.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What colour was the sky yesterday?
How did the speaker probably feel about today's weather?
Why did the speaker wear a warm coat yesterday?

vocabulary.definition: with bright light from the sun
white or grey shapes in the sky
not warm; having a low temperature

paragraph_translations: Hoy el clima está soleado. El cielo es azul y no hay nubes. Hace calor, así que muchas personas usan pantalones cortos y sombreros. Nos gusta este clima.
Ayer hacía frío y llovía. El cielo estaba gris. Yo usé un abrigo caliente y mis botas. Mañana el clima será ventoso.
